Try again tomorrow.  It amazes me that so many of these comments refer to the absolutely ineffective booking system, yet, the surgery don't do anything to change it.

Rarely are appointments given out of working hours, so you will have to take time off work to attend - awkward when you have multiple appointments and have to keep taking time off work.

I always leave there feeling like the GP has done the absolute bare minimum, just to tick a few boxes, and get you out of the room.  I'm never satisfied that they have actually listened to me, or fully understand my symptoms.

The reception staff are a bit hit-and-miss.  Sometimes they are really helpful, sometimes they're worse than the GPs.
